{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]  # Remove sentinel values

df = df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)

df = df.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')  # Keep highest sample_seq per patient

df = df.dropna(subset=['biomarker_final'])  # Remove any missing final values

# Correct assay_batch B values: they are in µg/L, not ng/mL
# So divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'] /= 10

# Compute improvement: final - baseline
df['improvement'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute mean improvement
mean_improvement = df['improvement'].mean()

count_after_baseline_filter = len(df)

count_baseline_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()

count_duplicates = len(pd.concat([df['patient_id'], df['patient_id']]).drop_duplicates(keep=False))

# Compute number of unique patients after deduplication
unique_patients = df['patient_id'].nunique()

print(f'Number of rows after removing -999 in baseline: {count_after_baseline_filter}')
print(f'Number of rows with baseline == -999: {count_baseline_neg999}')
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {unique_patients}')
print(f'Mean biomarker improvement: {mean_improvement}')"}
